# AI Nexus × Neon AI Studio

> Creative and tech studio led by Moreshwar R. Bhonde. We deliver AI video generation, AI video ads & reels, cinematic and wedding invitation videos, graphics & logo design, AI product photography, web & app development, 3D modeling, real-estate walkthroughs, promotional call automation, and WhatsApp AI chatbots. We work with clients worldwide — priority markets Dubai & the UAE, Luxembourg and Kuwait, then the USA, Africa and Russia (plus India). Remote delivery via WhatsApp, email and call; English-first communication; timezone-friendly handoffs; custom international quotes on request. Video plans from ₹599 (STANDARD) and ₹1019 (PREMIUM). Typical short-video turnaround 24–48 hours.
